rubric.why: Checks the meaning of torque and the quantities in its definition.
rubric.description: Defines torque as the turning effect of a force, or states that it is the product of force and perpendicular distance from the pivot to the force’s line of action.
rubric.how: Award for either the meaning or the defining relationship.

rubric.why: Checks the SI unit of torque.
rubric.description: States the SI unit as newton metre (N m).

modelAnswer: Torque is the turning effect of a force about a pivot or axis.
Torque = force × the perpendicular distance from the pivot to the force’s line of action.

items.followUp: A 4 kg block rests on a horizontal surface. Find the frictional force if the coefficient of friction is 0.25. Take g = 10 m/s².

rubric.why: Identifies the given values and gravitational acceleration used.
rubric.description: Records m = 5 kg, μ = 0.6 and g = 10 m/s².

rubric.why: Selects the relationship for frictional force.
rubric.description: Uses frictional force equal to coefficient of friction multiplied by normal reaction.
rubric.how: Award for the formula or its verbal equivalent.

rubric.why: Calculates the normal reaction on the horizontal floor.
rubric.description: Uses N = mg and obtains 50 N.
rubric.how: Award for the correct relation and normal reaction.

rubric.why: Shows substitution into the friction formula.
rubric.description: Substitutes μ = 0.6 and N = 50 N into F = μN.
rubric.how: Award for a correct numerical substitution.

rubric.why: Checks the calculated frictional force and unit.
rubric.description: Gives the frictional force as 30 N.
rubric.how: Award for the correct result with newtons.

modelAnswer: Given: m = 5 kg, μ = 0.6, g = 10 m/s².
On a horizontal floor, N = mg = 5 kg × 10 m/s² = 50 N.
Answer: The force of friction is 30 N.

items.followUp: A force of 60 N acts on an area of 2 cm². Calculate the pressure in pascals.

rubric.why: Identifies the force and contact area given in the question.
rubric.description: Records F = 75 N and A = 1.5 cm².

rubric.why: Checks the conversion of area into SI units.
Checks the formula used to calculate pressure.
rubric.description: Uses pressure equal to force divided by area.
rubric.how: Award for the formula or its verbal equivalent.

rubric.why: Checks substitution of the force and SI area into the formula.
rubric.description: Substitutes F = 75 N and A = 1.5 × 10⁻⁴ m².
rubric.how: Award for a correct numerical substitution.

rubric.why: Checks the final pressure and SI unit.
rubric.how: Award for the correct result with pascals.

modelAnswer: Given: F = 75 N, A = 1.5 cm² = 1.5 × 10⁻⁴ m².
Answer: The pressure under the thumb is 5 × 10⁵ Pa.
